# Sri Durga Cane & Wood Furniture Works

> Hardwood cane-netting easy chairs, jhollas, sofa sets and chairs, woven by a family that opened its first shop in Choolai in 1930.

Website: https://sridurgacaneandwoodfurnitureworks.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90030 91434

## Contact
- Sri Durga Cane & Wood Furniture Works · No. 22, Thirumurugan Road, Kamala Nagar, Porur, Chennai 600 116 · Near / opposite Agarwal Hospital · +91 90030 91434 · +91 99403 27359 · durgacane@gmail.com

## Key facts
- first shop opened in Choolai 1930
- the next generation took over 1965
- run by the present owner 1993

## Facilities
- Cane easy chairs
- Jhollas
- Cane & wood sofa sets
- Chairs
- Racks
- Baskets
- Cane weaving
- Wire chair netting
- Wicker weaving
- Furniture repair
- Polishing & re-strapping
- Shipping across India

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sri Durga Cane & Wood Furniture Works?
No. 22, Thirumurugan Road, Kamala Nagar, Porur, Chennai 600 116 (Near / opposite Agarwal Hospital).

### What facilities does Sri Durga Cane & Wood Furniture Works have?
Cane easy chairs, Jhollas, Cane & wood sofa sets, Chairs, Racks, Baskets, Cane weaving, Wire chair netting, Wicker weaving, Furniture repair, Polishing & re-strapping, Shipping across India.

### Do you repair old cane furniture?
Yes. We do cane and rattan chair weaving, wooden furniture repair, polishing and re-strapping.

### Do you deliver outside Chennai?
We can ship anywhere in India for an additional shipping charge.

### How do I order from Sri Durga Cane & Wood Furniture Works?
Pick a date in the enquiry section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 90030 91434.
